requirements.title: Corporate Action Adjusted OHLCV Continuity
requirements.description: Historical price and volume series must be accurately adjusted for stock splits, bonus issues, and rights issues without creating artificial price leaps.

requirements.title: Dual-Source Market Data Cross-Verification
requirements.description: Market feeds from primary broker (Kite) and secondary archives (Bhavcopy/Stooq) must agree within tolerance before final promotion.

requirements.title: Unambiguous Security Resolution & Collision Shield
requirements.description: Every traded asset must resolve to a unique MasterTicker, mapping NSE symbol, BSE code, and ISIN without namespace collisions or zombie ticker overwrites.

requirements.title: Generalized Business Model Taxonomy & Metric Selection
requirements.description: Fundamental metrics and interpretations must dynamically adapt to business models (BANK, NBFC, IT_SERVICES, INDUSTRIAL, CONSUMER) without hardcoded company allowlists.

requirements.title: DuPont Decomposition & Capital Return Integrity
requirements.description: ROCE, ROE, and ROA calculations must strictly preserve balance sheet identity; capital employed must exclude financial liabilities for non-financial firms.

requirements.title: Banking & Lending Institution Prudential Metrics
requirements.description: Financial lenders must be evaluated on NIM, GNPA/NNPA, Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR), and Capital Adequacy (CAR) instead of EBITDA, operating margin, or standard ROCE.

requirements.title: Walk-The-Talk Management Guidance vs Delivery Audit
requirements.description: Concall guidance claims must be verified against actual quarterly reported numbers over a rolling 4-quarter window.

requirements.title: Multi-Cycle Valuation Percentile Band Normalization
requirements.description: Valuation multiples (P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA) must be normalized against 3-year, 5-year, and 10-year historical percentiles rather than single-point absolute thresholds.

requirements.title: S1A Volume Price Alignment (VPA) 3-Leg Swing Setup
requirements.description: Strict compliance with S1A specification: 3-leg swing structure, volume expansion on impulse, volume dry-up on pullbacks, and swing high breakout validation.

requirements.title: S1B VPA Trough-Reversal Setup
requirements.description: Strict compliance with S1B specification: multi-bar accumulation base, volume absorption at price floor, and reversal confirmation.

requirements.title: S2A Institutional FVG & Consequent Encroachment Setup
requirements.description: Strict compliance with S2A specification: 3-candle Fair Value Gap detection, 50% consequent encroachment midpoint retest, and institutional orderflow alignment.

requirements.title: Multi-Broker Transaction Idempotence & Trade Deduplication
requirements.description: Tradebook synchronization across Zerodha, Upstox, and CAMS must use deterministic order/trade hashes to guarantee zero duplicate holdings.

requirements.title: Exact Post-Tax Daily Cash Flow XIRR Calculation
requirements.description: Portfolio and holding-level returns must be computed using exact Newton-Raphson cash-flow discounting accounting for net cash flows and terminal value.

requirements.title: Section 112A Grandfathering & LTCG Cost Basis
requirements.description: Capital gains on equity acquired before 31-Jan-2018 must apply grandfathered fair market value rules pursuant to Indian Income Tax Section 112A.

requirements.title: Model Context Protocol Specification Compliance
requirements.description: Universal MCP endpoint must conform to protocol version 2024-11-05 supporting initialize, tools/list, and tools/call over Streamable HTTP and SSE.

requirements.title: Dual-Plane Authorization & Profile Isolation
requirements.description: Product and Review planes must be cryptographically isolated: Product bearer keys must be rejected (HTTP 403) from accessing the Review plane.

requirements.title: Synthetic Data Quarantine & Provenance Isolation
requirements.description: Synthetic fixtures, mock estimates, and benchmark seeds must be physically isolated in quarantined tables and blocked from production screening.

requirements.title: Point-in-Time Universe Survivorship Prevention
requirements.description: Historical backtests and screening replays must query historical constituent snapshots to eliminate survivorship and lookahead bias.

requirements.title: Beneish M-Score & Financial Manipulation Detection
requirements.description: Calculation of the 8-variable Beneish M-Score (DSRI, GMI, AQI, SGI, DEPI, SGAI, LVGI, TATA) to flag potential earnings manipulation.

requirements.title: Autonomous Strategy Sensitivity Recalibration
requirements.description: Continuous self-learning pipeline proposing parameter refinements based on multi-regime backtest performance deviations.
